topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Rain hadn't been the only thing falling tonight. The room was a quiet kind of chaos when I got there. Papers littered the coffee table, each one a piece of a puzzle that didn't fit. She caught me at the door, the words almost choking her before they could spill out. Her partner, it seemed, had been penning a little story. Not just any story, but one that wore their life like a mask. I raised an eyebrow, took in the tension hanging in the air. "Looks like you found the plot twist," I said, watching her eyes for the unspoken. A novel, huh? People go to strange lengths when they think nobody's looking.
